name: Choroizm
source:
Tadashi entered the academy as his friend had recommended.
His friend Yuiko was smart so if he relies on her, everything should be alright.

They keep it a secret, but they are practically a married couple,
and are looking to get married when they start school as well.

Perhaps she will look after him for the rest of his life.

But is that really ok?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ250190.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
正听从好友的推荐考入了这所学园。
他的青梅竹马好友衣子头脑聪明，只要凡事依靠她，一切就肯定万事大吉。

两人虽然对外保密，但私底下早已和夫妻无异，
甚至盘算着一升入学校就正式步入婚姻殿堂。

说不定她这辈子都会这样无微不至地照顾他下去。

可是……这样真的好吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ250190.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
